question: Can every explicit state reached by the frozen normative machine be bounded by a polynomial state-size envelope in the original canonical input size, conditional only on exact-DP moves being selected from the already-defined root-budget envelope-admissible pivot set, or is there an explicit operator/selector transition that violates that envelope?

operator_contracts.R33_non_BVE: No new variables; no clause-count increase; literal count strictly descends on each accepted non-BVE R33 transition.
operator_contracts.R33_BVE: Exact non-tautological resolvents from existing parent literals only; accepts only when unique resolvent count <= removed parent count and canonical CLV strictly decreases. Hence no new variables, pivot removed, clause count does not increase; L may locally increase only while C decreases and canonical L<=C*V remains valid.
operator_contracts.RUP: Replace one existing clause by a proper subclause; C and V do not increase and L strictly decreases; no new variables.
operator_contracts.SA_BVE: Exact non-tautological resolvent pool followed by subsumption minimization; accepts only if canonical CLV_after < CLV_before; independent replay requires pivot removal. No new variables; L may locally increase only under lexicographic CLV descent and canonical L<=C*V.
operator_contracts.EXACT_DP: Only frozen operator permitted to increase explicit C or L. Resolvents use existing parent literals after pivot removal, so no new variables and V strictly decreases by at least one on every accepted bipolar pivot.

root_frozen_budget.scope: B0 is computed exactly once from the original canonical root and is never recomputed from later phase roots.

normative_exact_DP_selector.name: GLOBAL_ROOT_BUDGET_ENVELOPE_ADMISSIBLE_SELECTOR
normative_exact_DP_selector.required_child_contract: Exact canonical DP child must satisfy C'+L' <= RAW_S_UB(x) <= T_B0_V <= B0/2 and V'<V.

root_frozen_budget.explicit_scope_exclusion: AQ min(bipolar_vars) was a diagnostic selector used only for the outer phase-count audit. It is NOT a normative AR selector and any such unscoped exact-DP transition is an AR falsifier.

theorem_target.conditional_statement: For every execution of the frozen normative machine from canonical root F0, conditional on each exact-DP transition using the frozen global-root envelope-admissible selector, every reached explicit state Fi satisfies the root-polynomial envelope below.
theorem_target.nonterminal_simplification: For V0>=1, N0<=B0/2, so after the root and all admitted DP/cheap transitions one may use C_i<=B0/2, L_i<=B0*V0/2, S_i<=B0*(V0+1)/2 except for degenerate terminal-root bookkeeping.
theorem_target.input_size_corollary: Because V0<=L0<=N0 for an explicit canonical nonempty CNF, B0<=N0*(N0+1)^2=O(N0^3), C_i=O(N0^3), L_i=O(N0^4), S_i=O(N0^4).

symbolic_checks: derive cheap-operator preservation from operator contracts plus canonical L<=C*V
finite_replay_controls: guaranteed controls for every R33 rule including BVE
normative selector replay over inherited AH/AJ/AM frozen root domain with one global B0 per root
check every recorded exact-DP child and every recorded cheap-policy intermediate state against the root envelope

interpretation_if_success: Success closes the explicit state-size composition debt for the frozen normative selector/operator machine. It does not establish that every arbitrary-CNF residual has an envelope-admissible pivot, does not establish route completeness, and does not by itself establish end-to-end polynomial SAT runtime.
